input: Figure out childcare backup options for school holidays

gold.taskTitle: Figure Out Childcare Backup for School Holidays
gold.taskDescription: Identify and arrange reliable backup childcare options to cover the child during school holiday periods.

questions.title: How many children need coverage, and what ages?
questions.description: Understand the number of children and their ages to tailor appropriate childcare options.

questions.title: Which specific school holidays are you planning for?
questions.description: Identify whether this covers all holidays in the year or a specific upcoming break.

questions.title: How many days of backup coverage do you need?
questions.description: Determine the total number of days or hours per week that childcare is required.

questions.title: What is your budget per day or week for childcare?
questions.description: Establish financial constraints to filter realistic options.

questions.title: Do you have family nearby who could help occasionally?
questions.description: Gauge whether informal family support is a viable part of the backup plan.

questions.title: Are there any care arrangements already in place part-time?
questions.description: Understand existing childcare setup to identify gaps rather than duplicating what already works.

questions.title: Does your child have any special needs or preferences to consider?
questions.description: Capture any medical, dietary, social, or routine requirements that would affect suitable care options.
